lines.text: Every great edit has the same four pieces. Miss one, and people scroll.
The hook. The first second that makes them stop.
The context. Why this matters, in one line.
The build-up. Every shot raising the stakes.
The payoff. The moment they came for.
With vibe editing, you write all four into the brief, and the AI builds around them.
Save this for your next edit, and join vibe editing.
